title: phase-bk: atm task hooks, hook registration, atm cron, doctor hook section
description:
## Goal
Every `atm task` subcommand can be replaced by an optional hook registered per team and phase; the daemon runs the module with one JSON request in a fixed environment under the module's `TIMEOUT_MS` and acts on one of three JSON replies (refuse, pass through, run these atm actions un-hooked). `atm cron start|end|list` keeps schedules in the daemon store and one daemon worker ticks them through the same hook contract. `atm doctor` calls each active module's `doctor()` for the caller's team. Authority: `docs/plans/phase-bk/design.md` over Rand's verbatim rulings on atm-core #1873 (2026-10-18); anchors `docs/plans/phase-bk/anchors.md`; requirements `docs/requirements.md` §11.5, §23, §24; ADR-068, ADR-069, ADR-061 D6 record of 2026-10-18.

| Sprint | Authoritative plan | Tracker | Relation | Closure |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bk-1 | [hook registration and cron schedule stores](sprint-bk-1-hook-stores.md) | `atm-bk-1` | `root` | `contract` |
| bk-2 | [core hook contract, sealed traits and protocol](sprint-bk-2-hook-contract.md) | `atm-bk-2` | `must_follow` | `contract` |
| bk-3 | [hook runner and task integration](sprint-bk-3-hook-runner.md) | `atm-bk-3` | `must_follow` | `boundary` |
| bk-4 | [atm-cron crate](sprint-bk-4-atm-cron.md) | `atm-bk-4` | `must_follow` | `boundary` |
| bk-5 | [hook and cron CLI, doctor hooks section, composition, user docs](sprint-bk-5-hook-cli-doctor.md) | `atm-bk-5` | `must_follow` | `integration` |

## This Phase Does Not Close
The python module and its roles (phase bj); hooks on non-task commands;
cross-host hook execution; any replay of missed cron ticks.

| `HookRequest`/`HookReply`/`StopReply`/`HookAction` types, the three sealed core traits `HookRunner`, `CronScheduler`, `HookActionDispatcher` (`boundaries/atm-core/{hook-runner,cron-scheduler,hook-action-dispatcher}.toml`) with `Noop` defaults and doubles, re-exports through `atm_core::boundary`, protocol variants (HTTP API 1.13.0), `ATM_HOOK_*` and `ATM_CRON_*` error codes, double re-exports in `atm-runtime-test-support` | `atm-core`, `atm-error`, `atm-runtime-test-support`, `docs/atm-error-codes.md`, `openapi.yaml` | bk-2 |
| `DaemonHookRunner` over one `spawn_with_deadline` helper (process spawn, deadline, fixed env), `ActiveHookSnapshot`, router hook consult and reply dispatch for the six task hooks under one dispatch entry, `HookActionDispatcher` impl on the router, six registry/cron routes calling `CronScheduler` (default `NoopCronScheduler`), the `tokio::process::Command` site architecture test | `atm-daemon-bootstrap`, `atm-http-runtime`, `atm-architecture` | bk-3 |
| `atm-cron` crate: `AtmCron` impl of `CronScheduler`, worker loop (UTC next, stop check first, no missed-tick replay, one run in flight, reload on signal), `CronWorkerHandle`; `boundaries/atm-cron/cron-scheduler.toml`, forbidden edges | `atm-cron` (new), `boundaries/`, `.just/lint-config.toml`, `atm-architecture` | bk-4 |
| `atm hook`, `atm cron` commands (stop flags); `atm doctor` hooks section; bootstrap composition of `AtmCron` into the router and `DaemonWorkers`; user docs | `atm`, `atm-core/src/doctor`, router `doctor()`, `atm-daemon-bootstrap` composition, `docs/user-documents` | bk-5 |

## Wave table
| Wave | Sprints | Hard dependency (consumed artefact) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | bk-1 | - |
| 2 | bk-2 | bk-1: `HookName`, `PhaseId`, `HookRegistration`, `HookRegistrationStore`, `CronSchedule`, `NewCronSchedule`, `StopCondition`, `CronScheduleId`, `CronScheduleStore`, the two in-memory store doubles (the sealed core traits take these types; `atm-core` depends on `atm-storage`, never the reverse) |
| 3 | bk-3, bk-4 (parallel, disjoint owned paths) | bk-3 ← bk-2: `HookRequest`, `HookReply`, `StopReply`, `HookAction`, `hook_name_for`, `HookRunner`, `CronScheduler`, `NoopCronScheduler`, `HookActionDispatcher`, `ApiRequest::{HookRegister, HookDisable, HookList, CronStart, CronEnd, CronList}`, `AtmErrorCode::Hook*`/`CronExprInvalid`; bk-3 ← bk-1: `HookRegistrationStore::active_all`. bk-4 ← bk-2: `CronScheduler`, `HookActionDispatcher`, `HookRunner`, `HookRequest::for_cron`, `StopReply`, the doubles; bk-4 ← bk-1: `CronScheduleStore`, `StopCondition`, `record_stop` |

Critical path 4 (bk-1, bk-2, bk-3 or bk-4, bk-5); width 2 (bk-3 with
bk-4); sprint count 5. Stack order after wave 3: both bk-3 and bk-4 carry
`pr_target = sprint/bk-2-hook-contract`; bk-4 is rebased onto bk-3's layer
when both are done (parallel-then-rebase, Rand 2026-10-12) and the lead
relinks it; bk-5 is cut from bk-4's layer. Earlier cuts: the first had the
CLI in wave 2 and a docs-only docs sprint; the second had the cron worker
in `atm-daemon-bootstrap` after the runner sprint; the third had one
contract sprint covering `atm-storage` and `atm-core`. Rand's ruling (PR
#1877, 2026-10-18: "I would expect atm cron to be in it's own crate w/
simple trait exposing it's features.") and ruthless-boundary-qa F001 moved
the worker into `atm-cron` behind the sealed core traits; the one contract
sprint grew past the plan gate's 24 000-byte reliable-review limit once the
three traits, the doubles, the stop condition and the protocol detail were
written at code level, so it is cut by crate into bk-1 (`atm-storage`,
`atm-storage-rusqlite`) and bk-2 (`atm-core`, `atm-error`), sequential
because the core traits take the storage row types. bk-5 composes the
crate, so it follows both runtime sprints.

## Decisions
D-1 fixed hook environment; D-2 no sha in atm, drift is `doctor()`'s; D-3 one
daemon-side runner, the daemon register route the only hook-name validator;
D-4 `atm-cron` crate behind `CronScheduler`, `cron` crate 0.17 UTC, no
missed-tick replay, one in-flight run per schedule, args in the stdin
request only; D-5 one active registration per (team, hook), any roster
member may register or start; D-6 `request` is the `RequestEnvelope` JSON,
an action is `{command, as, request}` and is valid only when `command` is a
task hook matching the request; D-7 contract types and the three sealed
traits in bk-1; D-8 in-memory active-hook snapshot, `Local` ingress, caller
from the request, one dispatch entry; D-9 mandatory stop condition (`--until`
or `--until-hook`, `cron.stop`), `atm cron end` the manual stop.

## Governed interfaces (ADR-061)
- SQLite storage: two additive tables, MINOR; D6 record of 2026-10-18 on
  `docs/adr/ADR-061-governed-interface-schema-versioning.md` (this PR);
  bk-1 lands the D3 previous-consumer proof test.
- HTTP API: six additive `RequestEnvelope` variants, `HTTP_API_VERSION`
  `1.12.0` → `1.13.0` in bk-1, with the D5 record line and both
  `openapi.yaml` copies; bk-3 adds the six paths.
- Hook stdin/stdout contract: `HOOK_SCHEMA_VERSION` independent of
  `HTTP_API_VERSION` (ADR-068 D8); one key-pinning test in bk-1.
- Herdr IPC: unchanged.
acceptance_criteria:
## Success Criteria
- `atm task close` on a team with an active `task.close` hook whose reply is `{"success": false, "message": "m"}` fails with message `m` and the task stays `active`; with `{"success": true}` the close equals an un-hooked close; with an `atm-action` list the listed commands run in order with hooks disabled (ANC-001, ANC-004..008).
- The hook module receives exactly `ATM_HOOK=1`, `ATM_TEAM`, `ATM_PHASE`, `PATH`, `HOME` and the registered cwd, and is killed at `TIMEOUT_MS` with `ATM_HOOK_TIMEOUT` (REQ-BK-D1, ANC-012).
- `atm hook register` refuses a module without `TIMEOUT_MS` and a second active phase for the same (team, hook); `atm hook disable --phase <x>` keeps the rows inactive (ANC-010, ANC-011, D-5).
- `atm cron start` rows survive a daemon restart, tick in UTC at the next future occurrence only, never replay missed ticks, never overlap, and record `last_run_at`/`last_outcome` (ANC-017..021, REQ-BK-D4A, REQ-BK-D4B).
- `atm doctor` from the registered team lists each active registration with its `doctor()` reply or typed error and never fails because of it; atm stores no module sha (ANC-015, ANC-016, D-2).
- `HTTP_API_VERSION` is `1.13.0`, `hook_registration` and `cron_schedule` are additive MINOR tables with the ADR-061 D3 proof test, the six codes are in `docs/atm-error-codes.md`, and `docs/user-documents/hooks.md` documents the module contract.

## Validation
- `cargo build --workspace`, `cargo test --workspace`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `just lint`, `just test` at the stack top.

description:
## Goal
closure_type `contract`; target_boundary `BOUNDARY-HookRegistrationStore`,
`BOUNDARY-CronScheduleStore` (atm-storage, new; rusqlite implementations);
branch `sprint/bk-1-hook-stores`, PR → `integrate/phase-bk`; difficulty
normal. Governing text: `design.md` §4, D-5, D-7, D-8, D-9; anchors ANC-002,
ANC-018, ANC-020, ANC-023, REQ-BK-SCHEMA. Requirements `REQ-P-HOOK-001`
§23.2 (one active registration per team and hook), `REQ-P-CRON-001` §24.1
(the table); ADR-068 D1, D5, ADR-069 D1, D4 (the columns), ADR-061 D3 and D6
(record of 2026-10-18 already on this branch), ADR-063 D3 as amended by
ADR-069 D5 (fourteen capabilities; Rand round 5: "yes, we need storage for
cron").

## Scope boundary
This sprint owns the two storage capabilities every other sprint reads or
writes through, and nothing above `atm-storage`: the store traits, their
row types, the in-memory doubles, the rusqlite implementations and DDL, the
storage boundary manifests and the storage documentation. It edits no file
under `crates/atm-core`, `crates/atm-error`, `crates/atm-http-runtime`,
`crates/atm-daemon-bootstrap` or `crates/atm`; the core hook types, the
sealed traits and the protocol variants are bk-2's.

Owned paths (new unless marked edited):

- `crates/atm-storage/src/hook_registration_store.rs`,
  `crates/atm-storage/src/cron_schedule_store.rs`,
  `crates/atm-storage/src/lib.rs` (edited: two `pub mod` + re-exports),
  `crates/atm-storage/src/factory.rs` (edited: two handles on
  `StorageHandleParts`/`StorageHandles` + accessors
  `hook_registration_store()` and `cron_schedule_store()` next to
  `task_store()`, `factory.rs:246`),
  `crates/atm-storage/src/testing.rs` (edited: the in-memory doubles
  behind `feature = "test-utils"`)
- `crates/atm-storage-rusqlite/src/hook_registration_store.rs`,
  `crates/atm-storage-rusqlite/src/cron_schedule_store.rs`,
  `crates/atm-storage-rusqlite/src/hook_schema.rs`,
  `crates/atm-storage-rusqlite/src/shared_db.rs` (edited: `ensure_schema`
  call at the line-654 block), `crates/atm-storage-rusqlite/src/lib.rs`
  (edited: mods + factory wiring at `impl StorageFactory for

- `boundaries/atm-storage/hook-registration-store.toml`,
  `boundaries/atm-storage/cron-schedule-store.toml`,
  `boundaries/atm-storage-rusqlite/hook-registration-store-sqlite.toml`,
  `boundaries/atm-storage-rusqlite/cron-schedule-store-sqlite.toml`
  (format of `boundaries/atm-storage/task-store.toml` and
  `task-store-sqlite.toml`)
- `docs/atm-storage/boundaries.md` (edited: `## HookRegistrationStore`
  and `## CronScheduleStore` sections after `## TaskStore`, format of that

  Phase AQ amendment, naming the two capabilities under ADR-069 D5)

## Deliverables
1. `atm-storage`: `HookRegistrationStore` (with `active_all`),
   `HookRegistration`, `HookName` (`parse`, `parse_task_hook`,
   `is_task_hook`), `PhaseId`, `CronScheduleStore` (with `record_stop`),

2. `atm-storage-rusqlite`: `hook_schema.rs` DDL wired into `ensure_schema`

3. Boundary manifests for the four store boundaries: `io_forbidden`

4. Tests, same unit: `atm-storage` contract tests over the in-memory
   doubles; `atm-storage-rusqlite` tests on a temp database:
   register/disable/active/list round trip, D-5 refusal naming the other
   phase, `parse_task_hook` on the eight names and two unknown ones, cron
   start duplicate refusal, a row with neither or both stop conditions
   refused by the CHECK, `StopCondition` round trip for both variants,

  `ATM_CRON_*`); no hook process is spawned (bk-3); no tick fires (bk-4);
  no CLI command, `TIMEOUT_MS` read or doctor section (bk-5).
- `LocalServiceRuntime` accessors for the two stores are bk-2's (an
  `atm-core` file).
acceptance_criteria:
## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] (ANC-002) `boundary:HookRegistrationStore` `disable(team, phase, None)` leaves the rows present with `active == false` and `disabled_at` set; `active(team, hook)` then returns `None`; `list` still returns them.
- [ ] (D-5) `boundary:HookRegistrationStore` registering `task.close` for phase `bk` while phase `bj`'s `task.close` is active fails with `ATM_HOOK_ACTIVE` whose message names `bj`; after `disable(bj)` the same call succeeds.
- [ ] (ADR-068 D3) `boundary:HookRegistrationStore` `HookName::parse_task_hook` accepts exactly the six task names and refuses `cron.tick`, `cron.stop` and `task.foo` with `ATM_HOOK_MODULE_INVALID`; `HookName::parse` accepts all eight.
- [ ] (ANC-011) `boundary:HookRegistrationStore` `HookRegistration.timeout_ms` is `u32` and the DDL `CHECK(timeout_ms > 0)` rejects `0` (the value itself is read from the module by bk-5).
- [ ] (D-8) `boundary:HookRegistrationStore` `active_all()` returns the active rows of two teams and omits disabled rows; `InMemoryHookRegistrationStore.calls` counts the call.
- [ ] (ANC-018, ANC-020) `boundary:CronScheduleStore` a schedule started on one `SqliteStorageBackend` is returned by `active_all()` on a second backend opened on the same file, with `cron_expr` byte-identical and `stop` equal to the value started.
- [ ] (ANC-023) `boundary:CronScheduleStore` `NewCronSchedule` has no constructor without a `StopCondition`; an `INSERT` with `until_at NULL` and `stop_hook 0`, and one with both set, each fail the CHECK; `StopCondition::Until` round-trips as `until_at` RFC 3339 text and `Hook` as `stop_hook = 1`.
- [ ] (ANC-024, ANC-025) `boundary:CronScheduleStore` `record_stop(id, t, "phase bead closed")` leaves the row with `active == false`, `ended_at == t`, `last_outcome == "stopped: phase bead closed"` and `active_all()` omits it; a second call returns `Ok(false)` and changes nothing.
- [ ] (REQ-BK-SCHEMA) `boundary:shared-db` both tables are created by `ensure_schema` on an empty database and on a database created by the pre-bk `DB_MIGRATIONS` string; the frozen pre-bk statements still read and write afterwards.
- [ ] `boundary:HookRegistrationStore` both store traits are sealed, their doubles are compiled only under `test-utils`, the two `atm-storage` manifests list each double as the sole test double, the rusqlite types are not constructible outside their crate; `just lint` boundary check passes with the four manifests.
- [ ] `boundary:shared-db` `docs/atm-storage/boundaries.md` has one section per new store and ADR-036 names both under ADR-069 D5; ADR-063 itself is not edited.

- `cargo clippy -p atm-storage -p atm-storage-rusqlite --all-targets -- -D warnings`

title: bk-2: core hook contract, sealed traits and protocol: HookRequest/HookReply/HookAction/StopReply, sealed HookRunner, CronScheduler, HookActionDispatcher with Noop defaults and doubles, six protocol variants, six error codes, HTTP API 1.13.0
description:
## Goal
closure_type `contract`; target_boundary the core hook contract
(`atm_core::hook`, the sealed `atm_core::boundary::{HookRunner,
CronScheduler, HookActionDispatcher}`), the six registry and schedule
protocol variants, and the `ATM_HOOK_*`/`ATM_CRON_*` error codes; branch
`sprint/bk-2-hook-contract`, PR → the stack top above bk-1
(`sprint/bk-1-hook-stores`); difficulty normal. Consumes bk-1: `HookName`,
`PhaseId`, `HookRegistration`, `HookRegistrationStore`, `CronSchedule`,
`NewCronSchedule`, `StopCondition`, `CronScheduleId`, `CronScheduleStore`,
`InMemoryHookRegistrationStore`, `InMemoryCronScheduleStore`. Governing
text: `design.md` §2, D-3, D-4, D-6, D-7, D-9; anchors ANC-003, ANC-007,
ANC-013, ANC-022, REQ-BK-D3, REQ-BK-ERRORS. Requirements
`REQ-CORE-HOOK-001`, `REQ-CORE-HOOK-002`, `REQ-P-HOOK-001` §23.2 (the
contract types); ADR-068 D1, D2, D3, D8, ADR-069 D2, D4 (`cron.stop` reply),
ADR-061 D5 (record of 2026-10-18 already on this branch).

## Scope boundary
This sprint owns every type and trait the runtime sprints consume and
nothing that runs a process, serves a request or touches SQLite: the hook
request/reply/action types, the three sealed boundary traits with their
`Noop` defaults and test doubles, the storage re-exports, the protocol
variants, the error codes and the OpenAPI schemas. It edits no file under
`crates/atm-storage*`, `crates/atm-http-runtime`,
`crates/atm-daemon-bootstrap`, `crates/atm` or `crates/atm-core/src/doctor`.

Owned paths (new unless marked edited):

- `crates/atm-core/src/hook/mod.rs`, `crates/atm-core/src/hook/request.rs`,
  `crates/atm-core/src/hook/reply.rs`,
  `crates/atm-core/src/boundary/hook_runner.rs`,
  `crates/atm-core/src/boundary/cron_scheduler.rs`,
  `crates/atm-core/src/boundary/hook_action_dispatcher.rs`,
  `crates/atm-core/src/boundary/mod.rs` (edited: re-exports below, the
  `mod.rs:10-36` pattern), `crates/atm-core/src/lib.rs` (edited:
  `pub mod hook`), `crates/atm-core/src/service_runtime.rs` (edited:
  `hook_registration_store()` and `cron_schedule_store()` next to
  `task_store()`, line 515), `crates/atm-core/src/protocol.rs` (edited: six
  request and six response variants, `HTTP_API_VERSION` to `1.13.0`),
  `crates/atm-core/src/api.rs` (edited: six `ApiRequest` variants mirroring
  the protocol ones, `From<RequestEnvelope>` arms at line 536,
  `ApiRequest::task_envelope`)
- `crates/atm-error/src/error_codes.rs` (edited: six variants),
  `docs/atm-error-codes.md` (edited: new `### 5.11 Task Hooks And Cron`
  with one `#### 5.11.n` entry per code and six `## 7.1` table rows)
- `docs/atm-http-runtime/openapi.yaml` and `crates/atm/openapi.yaml`
  (edited: `info.version` `1.13.0`, the twelve new schemas under
  `components.schemas`; the paths are bk-3's),
  `crates/atm/tests/openapi_surface_baseline.json` (edited: the version and
  schema additions), `docs/adr/ADR-061-governed-interface-schema-versioning.md`
  (edited: one D5 record line for `1.12.0` to `1.13.0`)
- `boundaries/atm-core/hook-runner.toml`,
  `boundaries/atm-core/cron-scheduler.toml`,
  `boundaries/atm-core/hook-action-dispatcher.toml` (the last two
  `visibility = "trait_only"`, format of
  `boundaries/atm-core/message-received-hook-emitter.toml`)
- `crates/atm-runtime-test-support/src/lib.rs` (edited: `pub use
  atm_storage::testing::{InMemoryHookRegistrationStore,
  InMemoryCronScheduleStore}`, `pub use atm_core::boundary::{DummyHookRunner,
  RecordingHookActionDispatcher, RecordingCronScheduler}`), so that
  `atm-http-runtime`, `atm-cron` and `atm` reach every double without an
  `atm_storage` import

## Deliverables
1. `atm-core::hook`: `HookRequest`, `HookCaller`, `HOOK_SCHEMA_VERSION`,
   `for_envelope`, `for_cron`, `hook_name_for`, `HookReply`, `HookAction`,
   `StopReply`, `HookOutcome` as above. `HookRequest` is the one JSON
   request every hook receives, task hooks and cron hooks alike: the seven
   keys `schema_version`, `hook`, `team`, `phase`, `caller` (`identity`,
   `team`, `host` of the caller), `request`, `custom`, and nothing else;
   there is no second request shape (ANC-003). An action's `request` is
   the HTTP API body itself (the `RequestEnvelope` JSON the CLI would
   send); there is no separate action dialect, and `HookAction` has only
   `command`, `as` and `request` (ANC-007); `HookReply::parse` accepts exactly
   the three §2.2 shapes and rejects anything else with `HookMalformed`,
   running no subcommand logic of its own (the exit-code and deadline
   mapping to `HookExit` and `HookTimeout` is produced by bk-3's runner
   from the codes this sprint defines); `StopReply::parse` accepts exactly
   the two D-9 shapes; `HookAction::envelope` refuses a `command` outside
   the six task hooks and a `request` whose own `hook_name_for` is not
   `command` (both `HookMalformed`, D-6), then deserializes `request` with
   `RequestEnvelope` and overrides `caller_identity` with `as` on `Write`,
   `TaskMove`, `List`. `hook_name_for(&ApiRequest)` maps each of the six
   task-bearing requests to its own name (ANC-013), and
   `ApiRequest::task_envelope` gives the router the wire form to embed as
   `request` (D-6): `Write` with a task id and no `task_op` → `task.assign`,

   `tick_request_has_the_seven_keys_and_args_in_request_only`,

- [ ] (ANC-011) `req:REQ-P-HOOK-001` `atm hook register task.close --module no_timeout.py --phase bk` exits non-zero with `ATM_HOOK_MODULE_INVALID` and the daemon receives no request (router request counter 0); with `valid_hook.py` (`TIMEOUT_MS = 2500`) the stored row has `timeout_ms == 2500`.
- [ ] (ANC-013) `req:REQ-P-HOOK-003` `atm hook register cron.tick ...` and `atm hook register task.foo ...` exit non-zero printing the daemon's `ATM_HOOK_MODULE_INVALID` message; `rg -n 'parse_task_hook|TASK_HOOKS' crates/atm/src` is empty (the daemon is the only validator).
- [ ] (D-5) `req:REQ-P-HOOK-003` registering `task.close` for phase `bk` while `bj`'s is active prints a message containing `bj` and exits non-zero; after `atm hook disable --phase bj` it succeeds.
- [ ] (ANC-010) `req:REQ-P-HOOK-003` `atm hook disable --phase bk` prints the six rows it changed and `atm hook list --json` shows them with `"active": false` and a `disabled_at`.
- [ ] (ANC-015) `req:REQ-P-HOOK-004` with one active registration whose `DummyHookRunner` doctor reply is `{"manifest":"ok"}`, `atm doctor --json` has `hooks[0].reply == {"manifest":"ok"}` and `hooks[0].hook == "task.close"`; the human output prints the `Hooks` block.
- [ ] (ANC-016) `req:REQ-P-HOOK-004` a doctor reply of `Err(ATM_HOOK_TIMEOUT)` yields `hooks[0].error.code == "ATM_HOOK_TIMEOUT"`, the exit status and `summary` equal those of the same database with no registration.
- [ ] (D-2) `req:REQ-P-HOOK-004` no field of `HookRegistration`, `CronSchedule`, `HookDoctorEntry` or any `atm hook`/`atm cron` flag names a sha (`rg -i 'sha' crates/atm/src/commands/hook.rs crates/atm/src/commands/cron.rs crates/atm-core/src/doctor/hooks.rs` is empty).
- [ ] (ANC-019) `req:REQ-P-CRON-001` `atm cron start nightly --cron "0 0 2 * * * *" --module valid_hook.py --phase bk --until-hook --args status --json` stores `args == ["status", "--json"]`, `cron_expr` byte-identical, `timeout_ms == 2500`, `stop == Hook`; `atm cron list --json` shows the row with `"stop": {"kind": "hook"}`; after `record_run(id, t, "ok")` the list shows `last_run_at == t` and `last_outcome == "ok"`.
- [ ] (ANC-023) `req:REQ-P-CRON-001` `atm cron start x --cron "0 * * * * * *" --module valid_hook.py --phase bk` (no stop flag) and the same with both `--until 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z --until-hook` exit non-zero with a clap usage error naming `--until`/`--until-hook`, and the router request counter is 0; with `--until 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z` alone the stored row has `stop == Until { at: 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z }` and the human list prints `until 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z` under `STOP`.
- [ ] (REQ-BK-HOOK-CLI) `req:REQ-P-CRON-001` `atm cron start x --cron "x y" ...` exits non-zero printing the daemon's `ATM_CRON_EXPR_INVALID` message and `atm cron list` is empty; `atm cron end --phase bk` keeps the rows with `ended_at` set.
- [ ] (REQ-BK-TESTS) `req:REQ-P-HOOK-001` `close_end_to_end_with_refusing_hook_leaves_task_open` passes: `atm task close` against a registered refusing fixture returns the hook's message and `atm task list` still shows the task `active`.
- [ ] (ANC-017, ANC-024, REQ-P-CRON-002) `req:REQ-P-CRON-002` `fixture_cron_receives_args_through_the_composed_scheduler` passes: the fixture's output file holds the `cron.stop` request then the `cron.tick` request with `{"args": ["status", "--json"]}` read from stdin, each with `sys.argv[1:]` equal to its hook name only; `atm cron list --json` then shows `last_outcome == "ok"`, and after the marker file `"stopped: marker present"` with `active == false`.
- [ ] (ADR-069 D2) `req:REQ-P-CRON-002` `run_replacement_daemon` builds exactly one `AtmCron`, passes it with `with_cron_scheduler` and keeps its `CronWorkerHandle` in `DaemonWorkers.cron`; `shutdown_replacement_daemon` records a `cron_worker` probe step (`rg -n '"cron_worker"' crates/atm-daemon-bootstrap/src/lib.rs` is one line).
- [ ] (ANC-011) `req:REQ-P-HOOK-001` `cargo tree -p atm -e normal -i regex` reports the crate absent (the `TIMEOUT_MS` read uses std only).
- [ ] `req:REQ-P-HOOK-003` `cargo test -p atm --test cli_surface` passes and the baseline diff contains only the `hook` and `cron` subtrees.
- [ ] `req:REQ-P-USER-DOCS-001` `docs/user-documents/hooks.md` exists with the eight sections above; `cli-reference.md` has `### atm cron` and `### atm hook`; `just lint` (site-links gate) passes.

## Validation
- `cargo test -p atm -p atm-core -p atm-http-runtime -p atm-daemon-bootstrap`
- `cargo clippy -p atm -p atm-core -p atm-http-runtime -p atm-daemon-bootstrap --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `cargo build --workspace`
- `just lint`
- `just test` (the phase's integration sprint runs the full suite)
